description: For nurseries that need maximum storage without sacrificing style, the Addison 7 Drawer Dresser delivers. Seven dovetailed drawers with full-extension glides offer generous space for clothing, bedding, and nursery essentials, all within a stunning solid hardwood frame finished in warm Brown Maple. The spacious top accommodates a changing pad, creating a dedicated diaper-changing station. Every finish is non-toxic and baby-safe, meeting the highest safety standards. Designed to coordinate with the complete Addison collection, this dresser transitions beautifully from nursery to tween bedroom.
